title.narrative: Strengthening Information and Communication Technology Systems for Efficient and Transparent Public Investment and Tax Administration Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will support the Government of Mongolia in enhancing accountability and efficiency of public financial resource mobilization and management through improved information and communication technology (ICT), especially for tax administration and public investment management (PIM).

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Capacity of government staff in administering and managing TAIS and PIMIS improved Indicator: At least 50% of staff (with 30% female staff participation) trained for maintenance and upgrade of the systems processes developed Progress/Status: In 2019, “Oracle database” training for 2 officers (female participants - 0%) from MTA IT department organized in New Delhi, India; and “Data Center Fundamentals” training in Tokyo, Japan with 2 participants (female participants - 0%) were organized. In 2020, total of 2 activities were organized - (1) Tableau training for 20 officers from MTA risk management and IT departments is organized (% of female participants - 30%); and (2) “Cloudera administration Data analyst” training for 8 officers (% of female participants -37.5%). In 2023, total of 5 activities were organized - (1) ICT for TAIS peer-to-peer study tour in Copenhagen, Denmark for 1 MTA officers (female participants - 0%),(2)APG annual meeting in Vancouver, Canada 1 MTA official attended (female participants - 0%), (3) Tax Administration Cooperation Forum in Tbilisi, Georgia with 7 participants (female participants - 57.14%), (4) SGATAR Annual Meeting in Seoul, Korea with 2 of MTA officials (female participants - 0%), and (5) OECD Information Exchange Workshop in Nagpur, India with 2 participants (female participants - 100%) were organized.
As of Q3 2024, 7 international study tours were organized, particularly (i) Transfer pricing - Train the Trainer Workshop in Turkey for 3 (female-1) participants, (ii) Tax Administration Integrated System and VAT system study tour in South Korea for 10 (female-4) participants, (iii) Digital Assets regional training in Malaysia (1 female participant), (iv) Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes to Armenia (1 female participant), (v) Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development's Transfer Pricing Train-the-Trainer Workshop to Georgia for 2 male participants, (vi) OECD's Tackling Cross Border Tax Evasion through Exchange of Information: Making Foreseeably Relevant Requests and Effective Use of CRS Data and EOIR to Mobilize Domestic Resource Workshop to India for 2 male participants, (vii) BRITACOM 5th Annual Forum to Hong Kong for 7 (4 female) participants. Also, 4 ICT System user Interface trainings were organized for 7 male technical staff of MoF in Ulaanbaatar.
In Q4 2024, 5 ICT System User interface domestic trainings were organized for 6 (4 female) technical staff and admin 230: Cloudera Data Platform tailor-made training was organized for 7 technical staff (2 female) in the PRC.
In Q4 2025, 2 training sessions under 3.a ICT System User Interface training category were organizer for 60 participants (26 female) and 3.c Training for maintenance and upgrade of systems processes developed category, 8 trainings were organized for 15 technical staff (7 female). Data Source: A report of capacity development plan; project monitoring report prepared by PIU Actual value:

Output: Capacity of government staff in administering and managing TAIS and PIMIS improved Indicator: At least 50% of staff (with 50% female staff participation) trained for ICT system user interface completed Progress/Status: In Q1 2025, PIMIS user interface training was organized in February for 178 PIU staff (74% female), and 2 Public discussions of Draft Law on Public Investment were organized on 21 Feb and 18 Mar for 286 (58% female) participants.
In Q2 2025, PIMIS user interface training was organized on 6 Jun 2025 for 216 participants in charge of public investment of 21 aimags and ministries and agencies.
In Q3 2025, PIMIS user interface training was organized on 25-28 August for 102 officials (68% female) and public discussions of draft law on Public Investment was held on 12 Oct for 27 officials (44% female).
In Q4 2025, 2 training sessions under 3.a ICT System User Interface training category were organized for 60 participants (26 female). Data Source: System users guide; project monitoring report prepared by PIU Actual value:

Output: Capacity of government staff in administering and managing TAIS and PIMIS improved Indicator: At least 50% of staff (with 50% female staff participation) trained for system-based management completed Progress/Status: In Q1 2025, (1) study tour to Huawai Technology Park to study the best practices for AI and high-tech for 5 MoF officials (2 female) in PRC, (2) 1 female tax officer participated in First Peer Review and Monitoring Group Meeting in France, (3) study tour to Japan and Korea was organized for 9 officials of MoF and Members of Parliament, (4) study tour to France and Italy, aims to learn best practices on tax law and tax reform system for 11 (2 female) MoF officials and Members of Parliament.
In Q2 2025, (1) study tour to Malaysia on “Digital Assets Workshop” for 1 female participant, (2) study tour to Yangzhou, PCR on “Seminar on Tax Administration and Digitalization” workshop for 2 participants (1 female), (3) study tour to Japan on “Special Techniques for Investigating the Cash-Based Economic Sector” workshop for 2 male participants.
In Q3 2025, 4 female officials from GDT were participated 54th Annual Meeting of SGATAR in Brisbane, Australia from 15-20 Sept.
Data Source: Guideline for the system-based business processes; project monitoring report prepared by PIU Actual value:

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: At least two of existing internal and external ICT systems under the PIMIS cycle interfaced or integrated Progress/Status: All consultants under this indicator are mobilized, studies and system analysis are completed and approved by MoF. PIMIS includes 8 subsystems which ensure efficient and transparent management of public information, including (i) Contractors, (ii) Design Author's Supervision, (iii) Project Owner/Client Monitoring system, (iv) Project Owner/Client, (v) Ministry of Finance, (vi) Public Participation, (vii) Content management, (viii) System administration. PIMIS is integrated into 25 public systems across 14 organizations, which are 6 internal systems of the Ministry of Finance.
In terms of the loan extension, the contracts of 15 individual consultants were extended until 31 December 2026.
In September 2025, PIMIS subsystem (www.map.publicinvestment.gov.mn) was launched for public and user access has been granted to Members of Parliament and the Government staff. This subsystem was studied and developed in phases starting from November 2024 within the framework of the Government of Mongolia's Action Program for 2024-2028 and the Prime Minister's Official Directive No. 2 of 2024. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Actual value:

Output: Business process for tax administration and public investment streamlined and improved. Indicator: Plan on business processes and system improvement for PIM prepared and approved Progress/Status: PIMIS business analyst consultants have completed the studies and analysis on business processes and system improvement for PIMIS, and the manual is reviewed and approved by MoF in December 2022. Data Source: Project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Business process for tax administration and public investment streamlined and improved. Indicator: Plan on business processes and system improvement for TAIS prepared and approved Progress/Status: MTA established a working group to develop manual on business process in December 2017 and the work is completed. The manual on business process and system improvement was approved by the head of MTA in December 2018. Data Source: Project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Customization, installation, testing, rolling out of the base system for PIM completed Progress/Status: The PIMIS version 4.0 was launched in April 2025, including additional developments and new design. Procurement and implementation of GD-01 (PIMIS end-to-end software solution and systems integration - ICT infrastructure hardware) and 2 lot contracts were awarded in Q1 2024. The base system is launched in 2020. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Development, testing, and rolling out of tax administration base system completed Progress/Status: Strategy and work plan for necessary milestones and methodology to create big data warehouses of tax administration and management and required activities to develop Big Data management capability are developed. Necessary software licenses of Oracle, Cloudera, Tableau and Talend are provided and in use (CS-05, CS-06, & GD-04). Tax administration web platform and kiosk design development and upgraded (CS-03). Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Maintenance and adjustment of TAIS and PIMIS conducted on a regular basis, at least twice a year Progress/Status: For TAIS, supply of FortiGate-2000E network firewall licenses for MTA (RFQ-08) and Office 365 licenses (RFQ-07) are completed (GD-03-01). Supply and install IT infrastructure for data center and disaster recovery sites for MTA - 2 year technical support contract was completed by 25 May 2024.
Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Needed ICT infrastructure for PIMIS installed Progress/Status: Necessary ICT equipment was provided to public investment units of all aimags and relevant agencies (GD-06, RFQ-03, RFQ-04 & RFQ-05). Un/installation and relocation of MOF servers and archive into the new data center is completed. The supply of necessary ICT infrastructure equipment for the new data center (GD-02) is completed. Supply of PIMIS Data Center Service Vehicle (RFQ-9-2) is completed in July 2024.
The contract of RFQ-9-1 was awarded on 9 April 2025 and goods were delivered. RFQ-9-3 was awarded on 30 May 2025 and goods were delivered.
The contract of RFQ-10: ICT Equipment for PIMIS developers was awarded on 25 Mar 2025 and goods are delivered.
RFQ-11: Supply of ICT Equipment for MOF system was awarded on 30 Sep 2025 and goods were delivered.
MOF decided to change the technical specification of GD-12: PIMIS Integration ICT Infrastructure Software and Technical Support, due to urgent needs under the TAIS. Final bidding documents have been cleared by ADB in Q4 2025 and IFB is expected to be posted by Q1 2026. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Needed ICT infrastructure for TAIS installed Progress/Status: ICT equipment and software were supplied, installed and configured for TAIS. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: Needed ICT infrastructure for tax offices installed Progress/Status: High-speed VPN network is installed in 300 points in 21 provinces and capital city districts in Mongolia connecting all tax offices to TAIS. a total of 23,640 meters of optic fiber cable was installed. Electric supply system and air ventilation system works are completed at the National Data Center (GD-07 & GD-08). Supply of some necessary ICT infrastructure equipment (GD-10) divided into 5 lots. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y

Output: ICT system for tax administration and public investment improved and strengthened. Indicator: New data center annex constructed; renovation of the office space for MOF completed Progress/Status: Construction work of the data center building is completed and it is in use, renovation of MOF office space (CW-01) and data center related consultancy work (CS-12) are completed. Data Source: Semiannual project monitoring report prepared by PIU Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2027 Target value: Y
Transparency, efficiency, and effectiveness in public investment and tax administration strengthened.

More than 50% positive response from user satisfaction survey on TAIS and PIMIS Progress/Status: The customer satisfaction survey for TAIS was carried out in 2020, in which 63.4% provided positive response.
The customer satisfaction survey for TAIS was carried out in Jan 2026, in which 57.2% provided positive response.
The customer satisfaction survey for current PIMIS was carried out on 24-25 February 2022, in which 92.31% provided positive response.
The customer satisfaction survey for current PIMIS was carried out in December 2025, which 57.5% provided positive response Data Source: User satisfaction survey conducted by MOF and MTA Actual value:

Tax revenues increased to 15% of GDP Progress/Status: According to the official report on the consolidated state budget performance by the MoF, annual tax revenue as a percentage of GDP was 30.6% in 2021, 29.2% in 2022, 31.2% in 2023, and 34.3% in 2024. Data Source: Annual tax report prepared by MTA Actual value:

Key information on tax administration and public investment management process disclosed to the public on accessible ICT platform. Progress/Status: PIMIS version 4.0 is launched in April 2025, including additional developments, and new design. The overall system development progress stands at 73% as of Q4, 2025. PIMIS includes 8 subsystems which ensure efficient and transparent management of public information, including (i) Contractors, (ii) Design Author's Supervision, (iii) Project Owner/Client Monitoring system, (iv) Project Owner/Client, (v) Ministry of Finance, (vi) Public Participation, (vii) Content management, (viii) System administration. The mobile application and web platform are available to the public providing key information on public investment and status of projects. Current basic statistics of the system as of Q4 2025 show that the total number of users is 32,479 out of which 2,907 are contractors, 1,111 are client, 705 are supervisors and 26,737 are individual users. Currently, PIMIS is integrated into 24 public systems across 14 public entities, which are 6 internal systems of the Ministry of Finance.
Two systems: etax.mta.mn and e-barimt.mn were launched in 2020 on mta.gov.mn platform. The platform hosts e-learning.tax.mn that provides information and learning tools to the public on tax reporting, taxpayer registration, e-signature, etax.mn and e-barimt.mn systems. As of the end of 2024, etax.mta.mn had a total of 759,493 unique users, while ebarimt.mn reached 2,247,464. The TAIS recorded 1,349 unique users. Data Source: Government report Base year: 2017 Baseline value: N
